records.process_description: Eligibility: BA students in the department (modules listed: 06SM360-BA Deutsche Sprach- und Literaturwissenschaft; 06SM370-BA Skandinavistik). How to find/approach a supervisor: contact the desired supervision person (check that they are authorised to supervise), confirm their willingness and agree a topic and working title. How to register: complete the online supervision request form (name, matriculation number, UZH e‑mail + confirmation, booking semester, chosen supervisor, module, Arbeitstitel). You will receive an acknowledgement to your UZH e‑mail and, if the supervisor accepts, a supervision confirmation—keep this. After receiving the supervision confirmation, book the corresponding module yourself in the Studierendenportal. Key formal notes/deadlines: the request does not guarantee supervision or module booking; booking occurs only after a supervision agreement (StO §26/31); booking semester options are shown on the form. Official rules: governed by the study regulations referenced (StO §26 and §31) — no full guideline link is provided on the page.
